text:
Sylvia (CS): forwarding customer note — AtlasCommerce says their April invoice is missing the 'marketplace resell' line and the PDF subtotal doesn't match the portal subtotal. They also say two PDFs arrived (one labelled "preview" but marked final). Screenshot: https://files.company/atlas-invoice-ss.png

Jake (Billing): ack. can you paste the invoice id?

Sylvia (CS): INV-2026-0412-AC-778 — customer pasted that. They said the portal shows subtotal $10.79 but PDF final shows $10.80 and the marketplace line is absent. Also received a second PDF with "preview" in filename.

BillingBot: [automated] billing-run v2 started for 2026-04-12 11:03Z, run_id=brun_20260412_11

Maria (Finance): looking at the run logs — snippet:
```
line_item_mapper: WARN missing sku mapping for marketplace.resell -> line skipped
pdf_generator: INFO emit_pdf INV-2026-0412-AC-778 final.pdf
pdf_generator: WARN duplicate_file_emit detected: INV-2026-0412-AC-778 preview_1637.pdf
tax_calc: DEBUG line_rounding_diff detected: line_sum=10.79 subtotal_round=10.80
```

Jake (Billing): that looks like two issues: missing SKU mapping caused the marketplace line to be dropped, and the preview job was retried and emitted after final. running quick query: `select id, status, emitted_pdf, preview_published from invoices where external_id='INV-2026-0412-AC-778';`

Maria (Finance): query result: `status=emitted, emitted_pdf=[final.pdf, preview_1637.pdf], preview_published=true` — preview was accidentally marked published. Also tax rounding: we round per-line in the current pipeline which created the 10.79 vs 10.80 discrepancy at subtotal level when we summed differently in PDF generator.

Elaine (Legal): per contract AtlasCommerce expects marketplace passthroughs to appear. Also note: we should not rewrite historical invoice numbers for legal/audit reasons. If we correct, we need to issue a credit note and then a new corrected invoice.

Jake (Billing): plan proposal: 1) remove preview PDF from public bucket + mark preview_published=false (internal audit retained), 2) issue credit for the incorrect invoice amount, 3) regenerate corrected invoice as a new invoice number `INV-2026-0412-AC-778R1` and send that along with the credit note. I'll run cleanup and regen. ETA ~4 hours.

Sylvia (CS): customer asked for ETA and an audit log showing who generated the PDFs. they want to confirm the duplicate didn't come from their integration.

Maria (Finance): I'll attach audit logs after cleanup. Patch notes: add guard to prevent `preview:published` transition if `status=emitted` and unify rounding to subtotal-final rounding (apply rounding after sum) to avoid line vs subtotal drift. Also adding a missing-sku alert so line_item_mapper fails loudly instead of dropping lines silently.

BillingBot: [automated] cleanup_job_brn_29654321 scheduled by Jake at 15:22Z

Elaine (Legal): please cc legal on customer communication and include the credit reference.

Jake (Billing): will do. @Sylvia can you confirm customer accepts credit + regenerated invoice approach?

Sylvia (CS): pinged customer — they confirmed they prefer credit + new invoice. :thumbsup:

Maria (Finance): I'll attach the log excerpt and a short summary for CS to send. Also filing a small post-deploy test for preview->published race (qa ticket Q-9876).

Jake (Billing): running the cleanup now, will post updates.

Sylvia (CS): thanks team. please add me when the new invoice is sent so I can confirm with Atlas.

BillingBot: [automated] cleanup_job_brn_29654321 started, progress: 0%

Jake (Billing): update: preview removed from public bucket, credit issued (CR-2026-00421), new invoice generated INV-2026-0412-AC-778R1, emailing now. ETA to customer inbox: <5m.

Sylvia (CS): confirmed customer received credit + new invoice, all good. they asked us to confirm the root cause once the patch is live.

Maria (Finance): filing follow-up PR with rounding fix + sku-mapping alert. will schedule deployment tomorrow morning with a short migration to re-evaluate historic invoices flagged by the missing-sku detector.

Elaine (Legal): received, thanks.

BillingBot: [automated] cleanup_job_brn_29654321 completed at 15:56Z, status=success

Jake (Billing): closing thread, will post a short retro in #finance-docs with steps and the customer-friendly timeline.
